LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE WORD CLASSES: PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns, part of Strand 4 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Which words replace names of people or things in sentences? 2. Which words do we use to show that something belongs to us?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify personal and possessive pronouns used as subjects and objects in sentences,

2. discuss pictures on the theme using personal and possessive pronouns collaboratively,

3. look at pictures and/or flash cards of a car near a bridge showing parts such as, wiper, bridge, head lights, signal lights, fog lights, and interpret the visuals,

4. make sentences using the vocabulary words such as wiper, bridge, head lights, signal, fog lights, and use personal and possessive pronouns,

5. construct sentences about the theme using personal and possessive pronouns as subjects and objects, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify personal and possessive pronouns used as subjects and objects in sentences,
2. discuss pictures on the theme using personal and possessive pronouns collaboratively,
3. look at pictures and/or flash cards of a car near a bridge showing parts such as, wiper, bridge, head lights, signal lights, fog lights, and interpret the visuals,
4. make sentences using the vocabulary words such as wiper, bridge, head lights, signal, fog lights, and use personal and possessive pronouns,
5. construct sentences about the theme using personal and possessive pronouns as subjects and objects, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is promoted as the learner is able to construct sentences orally with peers.

• Self-efficacy: It is developed as the learner gains confidence and high self-esteem when working individually to type

personal and possessive pronouns on a word processor, mobile device or tablet

Values:
● Responsibility: It is developed as the learner takes up assigned tasks when discuss pictures on the theme using personal

and possessive pronouns collaboratively.

● Unity: It is promoted as learners work jointly to read a newspaper, magazine or poem among others, to identify personal

and possessive pronouns

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: This is promoted as the learner is able to use digital devices to access information online during research on

personal and possessive pronouns.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to connect the concept of personal safety and first aid to their learning of similar concepts in Science and

Technology.
